report_title: GoldFlow Phase 3E — H4/H1-Confirmed SMC Entry Experiment
experimental_variant: Require latest completed H4 and H1 structure trends to agree and match lower-timeframe candidate direction
data_boundary_enforcement: Both baseline and MTF-confirmed variants are evaluated on identical trimmed windows (bars with time <= 2026-10-20T13:00:00+00:00). H4 confirmed end: 2026-10-20T13:00:00+00:00. H1 confirmed end: 2026-10-20T15:00:00+00:00. The StructureTrendTimeline.at() method returns None for any decision_time strictly after the h4_data_end_time / h1_data_end_time boundary, preventing stale-context carry-forward. All entry-frame bars beyond common_eval_end are excluded before candidate detection so neither variant can generate trades in the stale-context zone.

tick_value_check.reconciliation_explanation: MT5 symbol_info.trade_tick_value reports 0.1 (broker-configured table property), while MT5 order_calc_profit returns 1.0 USD per 0.01 tick for 1.0 lot, matching the contract formula (contract_size 100.0 * tick_size 0.01 = 1.0 USD/tick).

warnings: TICK_VALUE_RECONCILED: symbol_info.trade_tick_value (0.1) differs from contract formula (1.0), but MT5 order_calc_profit empirically confirmed 1.00 USD/tick for 1.0 lot across BUY and SELL.

notes: A captured symbol specification is still a metadata claim and does not independently authenticate data provenance.
The configuration values shown are BacktestConfig defaults; CLI/UI overrides must be audited using the corresponding configuration.
Missing values are not inferred from OHLC price precision.
Present-but-invalid numeric values are listed in wrong_type_fields; missing_required_fields also includes unusable numeric values for backward-compatible strict gating.

trade_calc_mode_name is resolved from the active MetaTrader5 package constants at capture time; the captured constant-value map is retained so the numeric code/name pair can be checked without guessing enum IDs.
Only documented linear contract-size profit modes are allowlisted; futures/tick-price, bond, collateral, unknown, and malformed modes are blocked from strict validation.
The calculation-mode check validates formula compatibility, not the broker's overall correctness or the authenticity of historical OHLC provenance.

M15.eval_window_note: Both baseline and MTF-confirmed variants are evaluated on the identical trimmed window (bars with time <= 2026-10-20T13:00:00+00:00). The entry frame had 5000 total bars; 4839 bars fall within the valid higher-timeframe data boundary.

mtf_filter_funnel.policy: Latest completed H4 and H1 structure directions must agree with each other and the setup direction.
mtf_filter_funnel.availability_rule: Higher-timeframe structure breaks become available at source candle open time plus the source timeframe duration; availability must be <= lower-timeframe next-bar entry time.
mtf_filter_funnel.data_boundary_note: Candidates with entry times strictly after h4_data_end_time or h1_data_end_time are rejected because no new confirmed higher-timeframe context is available after those boundaries. This prevents stale-context carry-forward beyond the dataset end.

baseline.drawdown_basis: Close-to-close mark-to-market equity; open positions are hypothetically liquidated at the executable close quote with modeled slippage and round-turn commission. OHLC cannot reveal intrabar equity minima.
baseline.note: Net profit and final equity include end-of-data liquidation P&L. Win rate, profit factor, expectancy, and average R exclude END_OF_DATA exits; TIME_STOP exits are rule exits. Max drawdown is close-to-close mark-to-market; realized-only drawdown is separately reported.

mtf_confirmed.drawdown_basis: Close-to-close mark-to-market equity; open positions are hypothetically liquidated at the executable close quote with modeled slippage and round-turn commission. OHLC cannot reveal intrabar equity minima.

interpretation_limitations: This is an exploratory full-history comparison. The bundled records have already been examined during earlier phases; this is not an untouched out-of-sample result.
Sidecars declare MT5 provenance but the broker/source history is not independently authenticated.
Candidate count and observed win rate can fall sharply after higher-timeframe filtering; small samples do not support strong statistical conclusions.
The context filter uses the latest structure-break state known at entry, not a full discretionary market-structure interpretation.
OHLC event simulation cannot reconstruct tick-level intrabar path or guarantee future live execution.
